subject.title: Bug: tools.deny does not hide skill_workshop from Codex deferred tools

question: Should this issue remain open until a live Codex/OpenClaw session proves or disproves the reported config-propagation leak?
rationale: The shared current source path appears to honor `tools.deny`, but the issue reports a real session where denied Skill Workshop guidance still appeared; deciding whether source proof is enough to close is a security-boundary proof choice.

options.title: Keep open for live proof
options.body: Require a live session capture or focused app-server regression for the issue-shaped config before opening a fix lane or closing.

options.title: Close from source inspection
options.body: Treat current main and latest-release source path as sufficient evidence that the central behavior is already correct.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow fix PR now
options.body: Ask for a regression-first PR targeting config/session propagation despite no current failing proof.
